title: A growing array on mmap
description:
Write a growable array of qwords whose memory comes straight from the kernel.

```
push 1 .. 10000
capacity: 512 -> 1024 -> 2048 -> 4096 -> 8192 -> 16384 (6 remaps)
sum 50005000, last 10000
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .bss
arr_data: resq  1
arr_len:  resq  1
arr_cap:  resq  1

        section .text
_start:
        mov     rdi, [rel arr_len]
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: Start with one page (512 qwords); a full array is `arr_len == arr_cap` (lesson 8.04).
`rep movsq` copies `rcx` qwords from `[rsi]` to `[rdi]`, which moves the old contents into the new region.
requirements: `arr_push(value)` grows the array when full by mapping a region twice as large, copying with `rep movsq`, and unmapping the old one.
Every `mmap` result is checked; on failure the push returns −1 and the old array is untouched.
stretch: Try `mremap` (system call 25), which can grow a mapping without copying.
